summary: Tested truck-aware 'take me to <address>' feature end to end. Backend: 21/21 new tests passed (tests/test_truck_routing.py) and the old regression suite passed 51/51. Reno from Sacramento returns route_set, category destination, source here, truck_aware true, '2 h 50 min · 132 mi', more than 900 geometry points, parking null, options []. Invalid truck_profile returns 422 on /agent, /route and /voice. ORS direct call, HERE-fails-then-ORS fallback, both-fail-then-mock (truck_aware false) and HERE/ORS geocoders all work. 'I need fuel' still returns route_set with a parking check and options. Frontend: the truck chip, the editor (fields, validation error, disabled save, reset, HAZMAT suffix), localStorage persistence and the fake-mic voice flow all work; the voice request carries the truck_profile form field. The nav card shows the summary in hours, route-notices for a 14 ft 2 in truck, and no parking block for destinations. Bugs found: (1) the editor accepts heights up to 16 ft 11 in (203 in) but the backend max is 200, so every voice turn then gets a 422 and the driver only sees 'Sorry, I didn't catch that'; (2) opening /truck-profile directly (reload or deep link) shows the defaults instead of the saved profile, so saving would overwrite it, and the back button does nothing when there is no history; (3) the geocoder accepts any low-confidence match: 'Qwxzzyplk Boulevard 99999' set a 1,929 mi route to Missouri City TX; (4) 'Sacramento airport' resolved to Airport Rd instead of SMF; (5) route notices are duplicated and cryptic. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: No match-confidence check. A gibberish query ('take me to Qwxzzyplk Boulevard 99999') fell through to a fuzzy ORS result, '12043 Mclain Boulevard, Missouri City, TX', 1,929 mi away, and the route was set with no warning. Should reject low scores (HERE scoring.queryScore, ORS properties.confidence below about 0.7) and return ok:false so the agent asks the driver to repeat.

minor.issue: HERE /v1/geocode is address-only. 'take me to Sacramento airport' resolved to 'Airport Rd, Sacramento, CA 95834' (6.4 mi) instead of Sacramento International Airport (SMF). Businesses and landmarks ('Port of Oakland', truck stops by name) need the HERE Discover (/v1/discover) or autosuggest API, with geocode as a fallback.

Notices are collected per section and not deduplicated. For height_in 170 the route returns ['Violated admin-wide vehicle restriction.'] x4, and the UI shows it twice. The text is a raw HERE code and the driver can't act on it. Deduplicate and map to plain language (e.g. 'Route may exceed a legal height/weight limit').

check_parking (satellite + vision LLM) always runs, even when place.category == 'destination'. Reno city centre returned verdict 'unlikely'. This wastes a call and adds latency; skip it for destinations, as the agent already does.

ui_bugs.issue: LIMITS.feet [5,16] plus inches [0,11] allows up to 203 in, but the backend TruckProfile.height_in le=200. With 16 ft 11 in saved, every /api/voice call returns 422 (seen in backend log). Clamp total height to at most 200 in (16 ft 8 in) or raise the backend limit. Also show a proper message: index.tsx submitTurn maps 422 to MESSAGES.notUnderstood ('Sorry, I didn't catch that'), which is misleading.

useState initial values come from useTruckProfile() before the async storage load finishes. Opening /truck-profile directly (web reload or deep link) showed 13/6/53/80000 while the saved profile was 14 ft 2 in / 48 / 70000 / hazmat. Saving would overwrite the stored profile. Re-seed local state when the loaded profile arrives (useEffect on truck, before the user edits).
router.back() with no history (direct load of /truck-profile) does nothing; the user is stuck on the screen. Use router.canGoBack() ? router.back() : router.replace('/').

issues: At 375 px the truck chip truncates to '13 ft 6 in · 53 ft tr…', so the HAZMAT suffix is never visible. Shorten the label (e.g. '13′6″ · 53′ · HAZMAT') or show HAZMAT as a separate badge.
The 'ft'/'in' unit labels are not visible in the half-width Feet/Inches fields (TextInput on web keeps an intrinsic width; add minWidth: 0 / width: 0 with flex: 1).
Web focus outline draws a black rectangle that spills outside the rounded field and over the neighbouring input; add outlineStyle 'none' on web.
A decimal entry like '13.5' becomes 135 (non-digits stripped) and only shows the generic error.
route-place-name and the address line both show 'Reno, NV, United States', so the text is duplicated; hide the address when it equals the name.

action_items: Align height validation: the frontend total height must be at most 200 in (or raise the backend le); surface a 422 as 'Check your truck profile' instead of 'didn't catch that'.
truck-profile.tsx: sync form state after the async profile load; fall back to router.replace('/') when !router.canGoBack() (back and save).
geocode.py: add a confidence threshold (HERE queryScore / ORS confidence) and use HERE Discover for POIs and landmarks (airport, port, businesses).
routing.py: deduplicate notices and convert HERE notice codes to driver-friendly text.
TopBar chip: make the HAZMAT state visible at 375 px; truck-profile: fix the hidden ft/in units and the web focus outline.
critical_code_review_comments: agent.py route_to_address always takes matches[0] without checking distance or confidence.
agent.py recomputes the active route through HERE on every follow-up turn just to build context; acceptable, but it adds latency and API usage.
useTruckProfile stores double-JSON-encoded values in localStorage ('"{...}"'); this works through the storage util but is fragile if another reader parses it once.

success_rate.backend: 100% of tests (21/21 new, 51/51 regression); 1 high + 3 minor issues found by exploratory probes

seed_data_creation: None. Generated /tmp/reno.mp3 ('Take me to Reno, Nevada.') via OpenAITextToSpeech for the fake-mic test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2); cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_truck_routing.py -n 0. Fake mic: the browser tool navigates before the script runs, so add_init_script and then page.reload(). The getUserMedia override must ctx.resume() and loop the decoded mp3 (src.loop=true) into a MediaStreamDestination; override permissions.query to 'granted'. Tap copilot-avatar-button, wait ~4.5 s, tap again to submit. The truck profile lives in localStorage key truck_profile_v1, double JSON encoded: localStorage.setItem('truck_profile_v1', JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify({...}))). height_in 170 reliably produces HERE notices for Sacramento to Reno.
rca_of_issue: 422 bug: frontend LIMITS.feet max 16 plus inches max 11 gives 203 in, above the backend Field le=200; api.voice throws on a non-2xx response and the catch in index.tsx submitTurn shows MESSAGES.notUnderstood. Stale editor: useState initializers read the module-level 'current' before load() resolves and are never updated.
